title: physics-loop: prove sharp overlapping-sector wall
science: Terminal EXACT-NONCOMMUTING-BLANK-OVERLAP-WALL-FOR-SHARP-BLOCK24-HARD-EXCLUSION-SECTORS — kills the collision-totalization shortcut that looked almost automatic after #7810 (form sharp eligibility projectors for every tip, jointly diagonalize, activate isolated tips, send colliding sectors to identity). That extension requires the overlapping eligibility projectors to commute, and they do not. Exact witness, derived by scanning all differences of literal support sites rather than assumed: fronts (-1,0,0) and (1,0,0), anchors (0,0,0) and (-19,-1,0), targets (-9,0,0) and (-10,-1,0), target shift (-1,-1,0). Current/current, current-A/target-B and current-B/target-A intersections are all EMPTY — the only overlap is two constrained qubits in the two target carriers, so the noncommutation is a selected-Blank conflict, not an old-Record overwrite or a label comparison. The two literal one-qubit fidelities are exactly 1/2 and 1/2, so the product rank-one projector fidelity is q = 1/4, and by Tr([P,Q]^dag[P,Q]) = 2q(1-q) the squared Hilbert-Schmidt commutator norm is exactly 3/8 > 0. The runner reproduces 3/8 a second way from the literal shared-qubit matrices independent of the scalar formula, and the tensor lift Pi_A = A tensor P_s tensor I_B, Pi_B = I_A tensor Q_s tensor B gives [Pi_A,Pi_B] = A tensor [P_s,Q_s] tensor B with the same 3/8 on the full two-tip space. The wall survives all 14x14 = 196 ordered stored-outcome label pairs, the complete 24-frame proper-cubic orbit, and every global translation (symbolic). Two negative controls keep it from becoming a blanket overlap claim: an exact shared-target pair has q=1 and commutes, and far-disjoint controls have q=1 and factorize — so the wall is specifically partial radial overlap with 0<q<1. Explicitly NOT established: impossibility of coherent, sequential, randomized, or unsharp CPTP arbitration; impossibility of sharp arbitration after adding an owned lease/tiling, orthogonal status carrier, or collision token. This forced the portfolio rerank (author-side five-physicist panel, 5-0) to the B0 endogenous existing-qubit lease campaign executed next in #7812.
